lines.text: The Keth line stays. I listened for it every dawn. Adequate.
The arch rose. The pylons did not. I will not say a word. I will say three.
A second path in the keystone. Ilsa thinks I do not know. I taught her to hide it.
You stood on the weakest span. I will not call it courage. I will call it a mistake you survived.
A Dominion seal on your name. The yard remembers. So do I.
